message: I'm a video editor and producer and I want a portfolio that gets me hired by agencies and brands for documentary-style work.
document_text:
Name: Lena Okafor
Role: Video editor and producer, freelance since 2022.

Work:
- Edited and co-produced a 6-part documentary series for a regional broadcaster (2024).
- Produced and edited brand films for two fashion labels (2022–2023).
- Cut short-form social edits for a music label's artist campaigns (2023).

Tools: Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, After Effects, Pro Tools. Also do sound mixing and color grading for my own edits.

Showreel: Vimeo link available on request. I have rough cuts of most projects.

Education: BA in Film and Media Studies, 2021.

I prefer a cinematic, editorial feel with dark tones and minimal text. No corporate template look. Keep my phone private — I answer email first.
goal: Get hired by agencies and brands for documentary-style video work
